// @path: src/app/ops/sign-in/page.tsx
// The permitted shape: a door file, on OPS_DOOR_FILES, opening with the narrow
// guard. It names nothing about the area it fronts (ruling R17), links nowhere
// (R18), and renders no media of any kind — which is why the enrolment step
// shows a setup key as text rather than a QR image.
import { doorView, requireOpsDoor } from "@/lib/ops/session";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function OpsSignInPage() {
  await requireOpsDoor();
  const view = await doorView();
  return (
    <main>
      <h1>Sign in</h1>
      <p>{view.stage}</p>
    </main>
  );
}
